prompt: Write four location moves for a market that becomes politically unstable as the party investigates a theft. Labeled fixture.
expected_output: Each move has actor, trigger, visible result, new opportunity, and lasting consequence; a place with no moves fails.

assertions.text: Moves are triggered by party action, faction action, pressure, rest, or another stated cause
Each move states the five-part shape positively (actor, trigger, visible result, new opportunity, lasting consequence) — negation-only mentions of routes/relationships/resources fail
The return state preserves history instead of resetting the market
